2026-07-09.patch_summary: This patch series adds a new mechanism to deliver interrupts across CPUs on arm64 systems, specifically targeting scenarios where the CPU has its interrupts locally masked. The current pseudo-NMI and FEAT_NMI mechanisms have limitations, such as introducing a significant performance overhead or requiring architectural support that is not yet widely deployed. This series introduces SDEI (System Description Event Infrastructure) as a new delivery backend, which allows firmware to deliver an interrupt into a CPU regardless of its DAIF state, thus enabling the backtrace and crash-stop paths to reach a masked CPU without incurring significant performance costs.
